# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

- Adapter: the verify budget only decrements on rounds that leave the output file unchanged. An agent that re-sends its save+verify block changes the stamp every time and runs to MAX_TURNS (seen as 62-message traces). Consider also counting identical-code or identical-stdout rounds against the budget. Separately, store transcripts (not only scores) in this run's trajectories so diagnosis does not have to rely on sibling runs.

- (iter 2) The per-task FEEDBACK classifier reported 183-8 as "answer cells hold FORMULAS". The real cause was unfilled '#DIV/0!' cells inside the range, which are error-marker strings, not formulas. Suggest classifying error-marker strings separately from '=' formulas. Also, "int where bool expected" type messages are produced by the scorer's own bool→round(float) transform and mislead diagnosis.
